meta.title: Stratified bubble sphere - multi-domain radial model v0
meta.status: v0 PROTOTYPE - ESTIMATED PHYSICS - not validated - paper model, nothing measured
meta.scenario: All five domains circulate P_circ at once. Wall heat = 0.1 P_circ [rec bracket 0.1-1]; Balmer light = 0.9 P_circ [est]; acoustic drive at the l=0 isolated-shell mode nearest 2 MHz; electric/magnetic: no drive mechanism defined (electrodes removed 2026-10-19; drive method open); outer surface held at 293 K (reference only, no sink chosen).

core_note.electric: E = 0: no drive mechanism defined (electrodes removed 2026-10-19; drive method open)
core_note.chemical: dissociation power 0.02 W spread uniformly in the gas [est]; fill converts to H2O in 0.00413 s releasing 4.62e-05 J (then a dissociation-recombination cycle with ~zero net heat); outside the core only surface recombination on the inner wall. Knee: not defined.
core_note.magnetic: B = 0: no drive mechanism defined (electrodes removed 2026-10-19; drive method open)
